name: Let game code set the camera's field of view
body: `lantern:::camera:::LookAt` rebuilds the camera with the default 60 degree field of view every call, so game code cannot widen a shot or narrow it. Add `lantern:::camera:::SetFieldOfView(degrees)` and make LookAt keep the field of view last set. Update docs/game-api.md and the committed host surface.

comments.text: Done: SetFieldOfView clamps to 10-120 degrees and LookAt keeps the lens. Host test reads it back; host surface and game-api.md updated (D-140).

acceptance_criteria: SetFieldOfView changes the projection and survives the next LookAt
A test in engine/tests/host reads it back through the render world
